reviews.title: I thought it would work.
reviews.text: I used this app last summer in 2024, it was really good and I made an account and I had almost 100 followers. But then I got it again on this phone and it started to not work. First thing, When I logged in, it would not let me actually sign in. It said that I had to be 13+ to join. And even though this is a 3+ app, it wouldn’t let me. Then every single maybe six scrolls it would force me to sign up even though it already wouldn’t let me. After I tried to get out of it multiple times just to get a little bit of a glimpse of the outside world, it kept glitching and making me re-log into the app. Whenever I finally did sign up and login it forced me to buy something. After I said, I didn’t want to buy it and I didn’t buy it. It kicked me out of the app for two weeks. The only people I saw was Faye Knightley. And another girl whose name is like Isabella or something. No hate to them, but I’m just tired of only seeing that two people or they’re not enough Nelson’s. If you could try to fix at least one of these problems that would be so great! 😃

reviews.title: I’m a very disappointed
reviews.text: Coverstar Is A Great App It’s Kid Friendly. But Coverstar is a little unfair sometimes! I always am posting videos and trying my best to take my time and make my videos good, but I get like 10 likes per video and it’s not fair. I have 1.2k followers and I have been on Coverstar for almost 2 years and People join and they are able to get verified in like 2 months. Especially challenges. Whenever I join Challenges it’s so unfair I work hard on learning a new dance or whatever the trend is and I barely get any likes,and someone who didn’t even do the trend and they just lipsync and they get 1st place. Coverstar also removes people from challenges for no reason they also suspend and ban people for no reason. I get literally no likes that I have to do “like for like”and I don’t want to have to do “like for like.” Also I know this app is meant to be “non-toxic” but there is always someone being mean, I end up getting in arguments with people all the time in the comment section. I think Coverstar should also add something where There are challenges for people with a specific follower count, like they can make separate challenges for verified people that they compete in so it’s fair and they can compete with someone that has about the same amount of followers as them. Same for people who aren’t verified they have there own challenges for them they can compete in with people who have the same amount of followers as them.
